scope: Local rich-language V2 task nesting, promotion and truly empty item exit through named Rust actions, closed Wasm commands and installed vanilla/React controls. Includes repaired native-widget keyboard ownership and an additive task-runtime capability check. Shared V2 is not implemented.

contracts.indent: Move a contiguous task range into the preceding task's trailing task list, retaining checked state, identities and all rich body blocks. Require a fresh nested ID iff no trailing task list exists; otherwise require explicit null.
contracts.outdent: Nested promotion retains task completion. The last promoted item receives the remaining nested suffix followed by later parent flow, preserving depth-first reading order. Top-level removal retains every body block in its actual flow parent; its exact inverse retains task identity/completion. Require a fresh suffix ID iff both prefix and suffix survive.
contracts.emptyExit: Only a collapsed empty leading prose head with no rich tail selects browser exit. Nested exit promotes one level; top-level exit preserves the same paragraph/heading identity and kind. Empty heads with media, quotes or nested tasks still split, moving the entire rich tail right. Explicit insertParagraph/splitTaskItem remain split commands.
contracts.explicitSplit: The supplied point must match the current collapsed caret, including affinity, so pending typing styles do not come from another context. Mismatched points reject without publication.
contracts.keyboard: The same stock Indent/Outdent controls prepare ordinary-list or task actions. Prose Tab/Shift+Tab routes task commands; code, modified/composing keys and native widget navigation remain separate. Focused widgets cannot navigate/delete a logically retained grid/node. Backspace/Delete on checkboxes/buttons are cancelled to prevent document deletion and WebKit browser-back navigation. Editor Undo/Redo remains available for checkbox changes.
contracts.runtime: V2 descriptors add taskStructureVersion:1; matching wrappers reject older V2 runtimes before owner creation/host mutation. V1 descriptors remain unchanged. Schema fingerprints, Document V2 and local checkpoint V1 encoding do not change.
contracts.compatibility: Default ABI 5, rich ABI 1, original V1 grammar/factories and shared model 11/journal 12 retain their meanings. Shared profiles still reject structural V2 before engine import. Every new action and Wasm parser has its own documented file.
